title: The Wrecking Ball Hit One Clay Pot... Into How Many Pieces? 💥
description:
Comment your number 👇 How many pieces did you guess?
A steel wrecking ball swings into one big terracotta flower pot again and again. Every swing starts a little higher and comes a little faster, so every hit lands harder. The last swing starts from much higher than any before it.
A piece breaks when the hardest hit so far beats its strength, and pieces far from the impact feel less of it. Fired clay cracks along curved shell lines that ring the impact point. Smaller shards are stronger, so each new crack needs a harder hit.
The counter shows the real count from the simulation the whole time.
No footage, samples or stock media.
#simulation #satisfying #physics
